response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced, versatile senior/staff-level software engineer with 15+ years across web, mobile, embedded and backend systems, and his current role touches MCP and agentic workflow infrastructure. However, the role requires 8+ years specifically building production AI-driven solutions with RAG, vector databases, cloud-native AI systems, and multi-agent frameworks — none of which appear in his skills list or work history beyond a few months of MCP tooling exposure. Python is notably absent from his skill set, and there is no evidence of data pipeline work for AI, vector DB usage, or LLM evaluation/optimization experience.
strengths: 15+ years of broad, senior-level full-stack and systems engineering experience across many languages and platforms
Recent hands-on exposure to MCP (Model Context Protocol) code generation and agentic workflow tooling
Demonstrated technical leadership, mentoring, and community teaching (workshops, talks, open-source projects)
concerns: No listed Python experience and no demonstrated production AI/ML system development history
No mention of RAG architectures, vector databases, or LLM evaluation/observability pipelines — all core requirements
AI-specific experience is limited to a few months in the current role, far short of the 8+ years required for this Staff GenAI position

key_factors.factor: Lack of RAG/vector DB and AI pipeline experience
Insufficient depth of AI-specific work history (8+ yrs required)
Strong general staff-level engineering breadth and MCP exposure
